name: coding-agents
description: Coordinate coding work in GUI Codex with official subagents. Trigger only when the user explicitly names Coding Agents or invokes $coding-agents; continuation is allowed only inside that already active workflow. Generic subagent coordination and .coding-agents presence do not trigger it.

interface.shortDescription: GUI coding coordination with official subagents.
interface.longDescription: Coding Agents lets the parent GUI Codex task decompose coding work and dispatch bounded responsibilities directly to official subagents. The parent retains task control, authority and safety decisions, worker routing, conflict resolution, integration, acceptance, and final reporting. Each worker owns one bounded independent output end to end and returns concise integration material. Optional file-backed state preserves only useful continuity and never controls completion.
defaultPrompt: Use Coding Agents explicitly to decompose this coding task and dispatch bounded responsibilities through official subagents.
Use Coding Agents explicitly; keep parent control, give each worker exclusive scope, and integrate concise completed outputs.
Continue this active Coding Agents workflow from relevant context; state formatting must not gate completion.
